cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(MetaxExperimentalMM LANGUAGES C CXX)
  find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
endif()

add_executable(metax-mm-opt SharedLoadAddress.cpp MatmulPipeline.cpp)
target_compile_features(metax-mm-opt PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
if(NOT LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI)
  target_compile_options(metax-mm-opt PRIVATE -fno-rtti)
endif()
target_include_directories(metax-mm-opt SYSTEM PRIVATE ${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS})
separate_arguments(METAX_MM_LLVM_DEFINITIONS NATIVE_COMMAND "${LLVM_DEFINITIONS}")
target_compile_options(metax-mm-opt PRIVATE ${METAX_MM_LLVM_DEFINITIONS})
llvm_map_components_to_libnames(METAX_MM_LLVM_LIBS Core IRReader Support Analysis TransformUtils)
target_link_libraries(metax-mm-opt PRIVATE ${METAX_MM_LLVM_LIBS})
set_target_properties(metax-mm-opt PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME shared-load-address)

if(TRITON_BUILD_PYTHON_MODULE)
  if(EDITABLE_MODE)
    set(METAX_MM_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../backend")
  else()
    set(METAX_MM_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/../backends/metax")
  endif()
  set_target_properties(metax-mm-opt PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${METAX_MM_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY}")
endif()

install(TARGETS metax-mm-opt RUNTIME DESTINATION triton/backends/metax)
install(FILES ../backend/address_pass.py DESTINATION triton/backends/metax)
